subject: POC Kickoff: Onsite vs Virtual Workshop - Scheduling and Logistics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff: Onsite vs Virtual Workshop - Proposed dates and agenda

Hi Jordan / Samantha,

Thanks again for the opportunity — excited to get the POC underway. Below are a couple of proposed options for a 2.5-hour kickoff + hands-on workshop where we'll cover: prompt review, routing and policy configuration, and a short load test to validate throughput.

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue, Mar 31, 10:00–12:30 PT
- Wed, Apr 1, 13:00–15:30 PT

We can run this fully virtual, hybrid, or onsite at your SF office. Quick Qs to help coordinate: 
- Do you prefer onsite or virtual? If onsite, who handles visitor access and room booking?
- AV needs (projector, HDMI adaptors, conference phone) and whether we can record the session for internal notes.
- Attendee list for access badges (if onsite).

Attaching a draft POC agenda (POC_Agenda_v2.pdf). Please let me know which slot works and whether you want us to book a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Facilities Team <facilities@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Onsite vs Virtual Workshop - Proposed dates and agenda

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — excited to move forward. We prefer onsite for the first day if possible to get folks comfortable with the hands-on bits, then virtual follow-ups as needed. A few notes from our side:
- We can do Wed, Apr 1, 13:00–15:30 PT.
- Facilities will need an attendee list 48 hours before for visitor access and badge printing. I'll loop them in.
- AV: projector + HDMI, Mac adapters, and room USB-C for screen sharing. Is Redwood able to bring an HDMI dongle and a local laptop for the load test?
- Recording: we typically require written permission from all attendees for recordings. Fine with us if Redwood records for internal post-mortem, provided we get the file afterward.

I'll confirm the final attendee list by Mon.

Jordan
Senior PM, Integrations | Acme Health

Subject: Re: POC Kickoff - AV and room layout

Hi Facilities,

Marissa and Jordan are aligning on Wed, Apr 1, 13:00–15:30 PT. Can you confirm availability for Conference Room B (the larger hands-on room) and share the room layout? We need:
- Projector + HDMI + USB-C adapter
- Table space for two Redwood laptops for the load test
- Whiteboard access

Attendee list will follow from Jordan, but we typically need names and company for visitor badges. Quick turnaround appreciated — can you confirm by EOD today?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff - agenda and load test plan

Thanks team — a couple operational notes for the hands-on session:
- Workshop flow: 30m prompt review / quality expectations, 60m routing & policy walkthrough, 30m load test (steady-state + brief spike).
- For the load test, we'll need baseline sample prompts and a short script; I'll prepare a 200-request workload to validate throughput and KV-cache behavior.
- Can someone confirm whether Acme prefers us to use a local Redwood VPN instance (private deployment) or connect to the hosted sandbox? This affects network permissions and recording scope.

I'll draft a quick checklist (prompts, test script, infra) and upload to the shared doc.

Soojín Lee
Customer Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed, Apr 1 13:00–15:30 PT — Onsite kickoff details and virtual fallback

Hi Jordan / Samantha —

Great — Wed, Apr 1, 13:00–15:30 PT is confirmed. Logistics below:
- Location: Acme Health, Conference Room B (Facilities confirmed availability).
- Visitor badges: please send full names + company titles by Mon 30 Mar for badge printing.
- AV: Redwood will bring a small AV kit (HDMI dongle, USB-C cable, local laptop for the load test).
- Recording: Redwood will record the session for internal notes only; we'll share the recording and artifacts after the session. If Acme requires a release form, we can get attendees to sign.
- Virtual fallback: we will include a Google Meet link in the calendar invite for remote participants; screen sharing and recording will be managed by Redwood. Link: https://redwood.app/meeting-link/abc123

Agenda (attached): prompt review, routing & policy walkthrough, load test, next steps and success criteria.

If anything changes on attendee list or AV, please tell us ASAP. I'll send the calendar invite and upload the final checklist to the shared doc.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for confirming. A few quick items: 
- I'll send the attendee list by EOD Thu, Mar 30.
- Recording: we are OK with Redwood recording for internal use as long as the file is shared.
- For the hands-on prompts: can Soojin share the sample prompt set by Tue so our UX and security reviewers can take a quick look?

Looking forward to it.

Jordan
